decisions.reason: The thermoforming unit has had its own page in both years, which points to a stable product that meets aspirations, and it fits the firm's established equipment business, so there is no shortfall to trigger search for other uses of its resources.

The orthopedic shoe last is newly launched and got its own page, so its results are still uncertain, and an established firm over 20 years old likely has the slack to carry it while it is evaluated against aspiration.

The post-curing unit is only mentioned on the website, a sign of low prominence, but it complements the firm's processing equipment line and is too new to judge a shortfall, so slack lets the firm keep it for now.
